name: sprint
description: FreeCRM BDD Playwright Test Automation Framework

scripts.test:headed: node -e "process.env.HEADLESS='false'; require('child_process').execSync('npx cucumber-js && npx allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean', {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.test:headless: node -e "process.env.HEADLESS='true'; require('child_process').execSync('npx cucumber-js && npx allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean', {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.test:multi-browser: node -e "const cp = require('child_process'); for (const b of ['chromium', 'firefox', 'webkit']) { console.log('=== Running on ' + b + ' ==='); process.env.BROWSER = b; try { cp.execSync('npx cucumber-js', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } catch(e){} } cp.execSync('npx allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean', {stdio: 'inherit'});"
